draft.subject: Photographing the French-American Piano Society's recital at Weill Recital Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw you're presenting a recital at Weill Recital Hall on September 12. Nearly ten years photographing Carnegie Hall have made that room familiar, and I work without a flash and without drawing attention. My portfolio is at danwrightphotography.com. I would be glad to talk about your photography plans for the recital. I look forward to hearing from you.

results.alreadyCoveredNote: The organization's site lists a Photographer in Residence on its About page.
